text_block_list.text:
—A crisp morning. Inside a room at the 
Ritto Dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(...Almost time for breakfast. Today's 
schedule is—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...No eternal polar night may stand before 
me. The hour of awakening hath arrived. I 
have witnessed the end of the nightmare.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Dost thou comprehend? My compatriot, 
Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
All of creation... Now, let drops of 
purification fall upon the deep verdure.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tears of a maiden, or the chalk of a 
thousand isles. —Let judgment be rendered.

At the end of her pointed finger sat onion 
dressing and Thousand Island dressing.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Shall we trace a two-toned cross... Heh, 
chaos is truly most fitting. Dost thou 
agree?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(—I have no idea what she's talking about. 
Most likely, I never will.)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The song of Yggdrasil, is it? An 
incompatible light pierceth this single 
wing. ...Yet Ragnarok remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(So this reply is good enough. It's not 
like she complains about it anyway.)

Returning to the academy after enjoying a 
morning stroll— I spotted Narita Brian and 
Tanino Gimlet walking together.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For the fixer to emerge upon the public 
stage. Heh... What resteth within that 
hand—the key to Pandora, or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a return from the flames of 
purgatory... So that is how it is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(...As expected, I don't get it. Not that 
I really care to, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Having things that others don't 
understand... is something even I can 
relate to.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Have you always talked like that?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Oho, hast the fleeting wind caught thee? 
Allow me to enlighten thee. From the very 
moment I drew breath into this world, this 
pathos hath only grown ever more 
ferocious.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What makes me who I am has always been... 
this heat swaying within the crimson 
flames dwelling in my legs.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heat, huh. If that's the case, then 
you're... the same as me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Overwhelmed by the torch lit 
within yourself? Don't let the mirror 
reflect the Ouroboros, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

—Shoot. I got so caught up in relaxing 
that it's already this late. Before 
classes start, I need to check the 
training equipment...
choice_data_list: You two need to hurry too!

Before the ticking clock sounds its final 
note—

text_block_list.text:
The moment I called out to them, they had 
both already bolted off running.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You better hurry up too.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The bell of finality won't wait for your 
arrival...!

Leaving behind those words, their two 
receding backs... vanished into the 
distance in the blink of an eye.

...Maybe because I was listening to their 
conversation, I ended up blurting out 
something weird.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ha! It seems we can't afford to close our 
eyes to the peace of the abyss.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...This is going to summon a storm. Are 
you prepared, Brian?

Narita Brian replied curtly. However, 
there was a faint smirk on her lips.
